items.title: Binwalk
items.description: Fast, easy to use tool for analyzing, reverse engineering, and extracting firmware images.

items.title: LIEF
items.description: Library to Instrument Executable Formats: parse, modify, and abstract ELF, PE, Mach-O, DEX, and OAT binaries found in firmware images.

items.title: FLARE-FLOSS
items.description: FLARE Obfuscated String Solver that automatically extracts obfuscated, encoded, and stack strings from binaries for rapid firmware triage.

items.title: unblob
items.description: Fast, accurate firmware extraction engine from ONEKEY supporting 100+ archive, compression, and filesystem formats with fewer false positives than Binwalk. Presented at DEF CON 30.

items.title: checksec
items.description: Shell script to check binary security hardening flags (NX, PIE, RELRO, stack canary, ASLR) on ELF executables extracted from firmware.

items.title: OFRAK
items.description: Binary analysis and modification platform that combines the ability to unpack, analyze, modify, and repack binaries.

items.title: cwe_checker
items.description: Binary analysis tool that checks ELF binaries for violations of Common Weakness Enumerations (CWEs) using abstract interpretation, with cross-architecture support.

items.title: firmwalker
items.description: Searches extracted firmware filesystems for interesting files, credentials, configuration, and known-vulnerable components.

items.title: VulHunt
items.description: Lua-rule-based vulnerability detection framework from Binarly's research team that operates across disassembly, IR, and decompiled code simultaneously, with dedicated UEFI module scanning support.

items.title: argXtract
items.description: Statically extracts arguments to SVC calls and HAL functions from stripped ARM Cortex-M BLE firmware without symbol tables, enabling security audits of Nordic and similar binaries. ACSAC 2021.

items.title: SCOUT
items.description: Deterministic firmware analysis pipeline emitting SARIF 2.1, CycloneDX 1.6 + VEX SBOM, and hash-anchored evidence chains; auto-detects Ghidra and runs P-code SSA dataflow taint with 4-tier confidence caps. Pure stdlib (no pip dependencies).

items.title: Angr
items.description: Platform-agnostic binary analysis framework. Brought to you by the Computer Security Lab at UC Santa Barbara, SEFCOM at Arizona State University, their associated CTF team, Shellphish, the open source community, and @rhelmot.

items.title: Capstone
items.description: Lightweight multi-platform, multi-architecture disassembly framework. Their target is to make Capstone the ultimate disassembly engine for binary analysis and reversing in the security community.

items.title: RetDec
items.description: Retargetable machine-code decompiler from Avast supporting ARM, MIPS, x86, and other architectures common in embedded firmware.

items.title: Keystone
items.description: A lightweight multi-architecture assembler framework that complements Capstone.

items.title: BARF
items.description: A binary analysis and reverse engineering framework with support for ROP gadget search and CFG recovery.

items.title: Angr Management
items.description: Multi-architecture binary analysis toolkit, with the capability to perform dynamic symbolic execution (like Mayhem, KLEE, etc.) and various static analyses on binaries. If you'd like to learn how to use it, you're in the right place!

items.title: Vivisect
items.description: A combined disassembler/static analysis/symbolic execution/debugger framework.

items.title: Open OCD
items.description: Provides on-chip programming and debugging support with a layered architecture of JTAG interface and TAP support.

items.title: assembly-repl
items.description: Native assembly, LLVM IR, C, C++, and Objective-C REPLs for macOS and Linux.

items.title: MCUboot
items.description: Secure bootloader for 32-bit microcontrollers supporting signed images, rollback protection, and measured boot flows.

items.title: wolfBoot
items.description: Portable secure bootloader for 32-bit MCUs using wolfCrypt for image signature verification (Ed25519, ECC, RSA, post-quantum LMS/XMSS), with delta updates, encrypted images, and explicit voltage-glitch countermeasures.

items.title: Grype
items.description: Vulnerability scanner that consumes SBOMs to identify known CVEs in firmware dependencies.

items.title: Syft
items.description: SBOM generator for filesystems and artifacts, useful for firmware package/component inventories.

items.title: Sigstore Cosign
items.description: Tooling for keyless signing and verification of firmware/container artifacts in CI/CD pipelines.

items.title: CVE Binary Tool
items.description: OpenSSF tool that scans binaries directly for 350+ known-vulnerable open source components (OpenSSL, libpng, BusyBox, and more), without requiring a pre-built SBOM; can also generate one from the scan.

items.title: AFL++
items.description: A coverage-guided fuzzer with enhanced mutations, QEMU and Unicorn emulation modes, and custom power schedules.

items.title: honggfuzz
items.description: A feedback-driven evolutionary fuzzer supporting hardware-based coverage (Intel BTS/PT) and persistent mode for extreme speed.

items.title: boofuzz
items.description: Actively maintained network protocol fuzzer and the spiritual successor to Sulley, with session management, target monitoring, and protocol graph support.

items.title: Fuzzowski
items.description: A network protocol fuzzer based on the Sulley/BooFuzz framework with support for TCP/UDP/SSL protocols.

items.title: GDBFuzz
items.description: Uses GDB hardware breakpoints as a coverage source for uninstrumented embedded targets — works on any GDB-debuggable MCU with no firmware modification required. Bosch Research / ISSTA 2023.

children.title: ILSpy
children.description: .NET Decompiler with support for PDB generation, ReadyToRun, Metadata (&more) - cross-platform!

items.title: Metasploit
items.description: Open source penetration testing framework (BSD licensed) maintained by Rapid7, with modules for exploiting vulnerabilities, scanning, and post-exploitation across embedded Linux and IoT targets.

items.title: kernel-hardening-checker
items.description: Audits Linux kernel Kconfig options and boot parameters against KSPP, CLIP OS, and STIG hardening recommendations; supports ARM, ARM64, x86, and RISC-V. Works in Yocto/OpenEmbedded pipelines.

items.title: IoTGoat
items.description: OWASP intentionally insecure firmware for Raspberry Pi and x86 platforms, providing hands-on practice for the OWASP IoT Top 10 vulnerabilities.

items.title: FwAnalyzer (Firmware Analyzer)
items.description: Tool to analyze (ext2/3/4), FAT/VFat, SquashFS, UBIFS filesystem images, cpio archives, and directory content using a set of configurable rules.

items.title: KARONTE
items.description: Static analysis tool that tracks untrusted input flows across binary boundaries (shared files, sockets, env vars) in embedded Linux firmware using angr-based inter-binary taint propagation. IEEE S&P 2020.

items.title: SaTC
items.description: Anchors taint analysis to string literals shared between web front-end and back-end binaries to pinpoint user-controlled input entry points; found 33 unknown bugs in commercial firmware. USENIX Security 2021.

items.title: EmTaint
items.description: Structured symbolic expression-based taint analysis with on-demand alias resolution for embedded Linux firmware; found 151 0-day vulnerabilities across 35 real-world images. ISSTA 2023.

items.title: Intel SGX SDK
items.description: Open-source Linux SDK and Platform Software for Intel Software Guard Extensions, providing the build/install toolchain for developing and deploying hardware-based memory enclave applications.

items.title: Samsung TrustZone Research Toolkit
items.description: Quarkslab's RE toolkit for Samsung Kinibi TrustZone: Ghidra loader for MCLF trustlet binaries, Unicorn-based trustlet emulator for exploit development, and Python bindings for communicating with Trusted Applications.

items.title: TPM 2.0 TS
items.description: TCG Software Stack for TPM 2.0 providing API for key management and attestation.

items.title: tpm2-algtest
items.description: Tests real TPM 2.0 chips for RNG output quality, key generation timing, algorithm support, and implementation fingerprints across 80+ firmware revisions from 6 vendors. From CRoCS (discoverers of ROCA). CHES 2024.

items.title: KillerBee
items.description: IEEE 802.15.4/ZigBee security research framework for capturing, injecting, and analyzing ZigBee network traffic using compatible radio hardware.

items.title: Cotopaxi
items.description: Multi-protocol IoT security testing toolkit from Samsung R&D covering MQTT, CoAP, AMQP, DTLS, KNX, QUIC, RTSP, SSDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, and more; supports fingerprinting, fuzzing, and known-vulnerability identification across 14 protocols.

items.title: U-Fuzz
items.description: Universal stateful fuzzer that infers a protocol's state machine from a handful of benign packet captures, then generates crashing test cases; demonstrated against CoAP, Zigbee, and 5G NR.

items.title: BtleJuice
items.description: Bluetooth Low Energy MITM proxy framework for real-time interception and manipulation of BLE communications.

items.title: GATTacker
items.description: BLE MITM tool for intercepting and relaying GATT profiles to test BLE device authentication and data integrity.

items.title: InternalBlue
items.description: Bluetooth experimentation framework enabling binary patching, LMP injection, and live monitoring of Broadcom/Cypress firmware on commodity devices (iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Raspberry Pi) without custom hardware.

items.title: BlueToolkit
items.description: Modular black-box vulnerability testing framework for Bluetooth Classic and BLE with Recon/Exploit/Report modules covering 40+ public exploits (MITM, RCE, DoS); used to uncover 128 vulnerabilities across 22 vehicles from major automakers. USENIX WOOT 2025.

items.title: BrakTooth
items.description: Directed exploit suite for Bluetooth Classic LMP layer vulnerabilities, targeting protocol layers inaccessible from standard host stacks; affected 1,400+ products from Intel, Qualcomm, and Broadcom. USENIX Security 2022.

items.title: SweynTooth
items.description: Runnable PoC exploits for 18 BLE link-layer and L2CAP vulnerabilities across TI, NXP, Cypress, Dialog, Microchip, and STMicro SDKs, including full pairing bypass and link-layer overflows. USENIX ATC 2020.

items.title: WHAD Framework
items.description: Hardware-agnostic multi-protocol wireless security framework (BLE, Zigbee, Enhanced ShockBurst, ANT) using a cheap nRF52840 dongle as a universal attack radio; foundation for Quarkslab's BLE GATT fuzzer. DEF CON 32 (2024).

items.title: VFuzz
items.description: The only dedicated open-source Z-Wave security fuzzer; uses a Field Prioritization Algorithm to mutate protocol-valid frames and assess target encryption capabilities. IEEE Access 2022.

items.title: Z-Fuzzer
items.description: Coverage-guided Zigbee protocol fuzzer using a software simulator with pre-defined peripheral and interrupt configurations; found 6 CVEs in TI Z-Stack. ACM Digital Threats 2022.

items.title: Rayhunter
items.description: EFF's open source Rust tool that runs on a cheap mobile hotspot to detect cell-site simulators (IMSI catchers/Stingrays) by monitoring signaling traffic for suspicious behavior like forced 2G downgrades.

items.title: FirmWire
items.description: Full-system emulation platform for Samsung (Shannon) and MediaTek cellular baseband firmware with AFL++ fuzzing integration, a task-injection ModKit, and dynamic debugging support. Found 7 pre-authentication memory corruptions. NDSS 2022.

items.title: OsmocomBB
items.description: Free Software GSM baseband (Layer 1-3) implementation for TI Calypso-based phones, replacing proprietary baseband firmware entirely and enabling open research into the GSM air interface.

items.title: emba
items.description: Efficient malware analysis framework for embedded firmware with scanning and reporting.

items.title: Firmware Analysis Toolkit
items.description: Automated tool for firmware emulation and vulnerability discovery.

items.title: Firmware Security Testing
items.description: OWASP firmware security testing methodology and practical guidance for assessing embedded devices.

items.title: EMBArk
items.description: Enterprise web interface for EMBA providing multi-user scan management, aggregated vulnerability dashboards, and CI/CD integration for continuous firmware security monitoring.

items.title: Unicorn Engine
items.description: A lightweight multi-architecture CPU emulator framework providing pure CPU emulation for ARM, MIPS, x86, RISC-V, and more.

items.title: Qiling
items.description: An advanced binary emulation framework supporting cross-platform OS-level emulation for Windows, Linux, Android, BSD, UEFI, and multiple architectures.

items.title: PANDA
items.description: Platform for Architecture-Neutral Dynamic Analysis with record/replay functionality and LLVM IR translation for whole-system analysis.

items.title: Firmadyne
items.description: Automated system for emulating and analyzing Linux-based embedded firmware; extracts and boots firmware images in QEMU to enable dynamic vulnerability discovery.

items.title: FirmAE
items.description: An automated framework for emulation and vulnerability analysis of IoT firmware with an 79% success rate using arbitration techniques.

items.title: Avatar2
items.description: Dynamic analysis orchestration framework for binary firmware that coordinates execution across emulators (QEMU, Unicorn) and real hardware targets.

items.title: HALucinator
items.description: MCU firmware emulation framework that replaces Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) functions with high-level models, enabling full firmware execution without physical hardware.

items.title: FirmSolo
items.description: Reverse-engineers vendor Linux kernel module version magic to load proprietary drivers into a compatible kernel for dynamic analysis and fuzzing, unlocking code previously inaccessible to emulators. USENIX Security 2023.

items.title: Fuzzware
items.description: Automatically models MMIO peripheral inputs via symbolic execution to enable coverage-guided fuzzing of ARM Cortex-M firmware with no hardware required. Achieves up to 3.25× coverage over prior approaches. USENIX Security 2022.

items.title: Icicle
items.description: Rust-based grey-box fuzzer with architecture-agnostic coverage instrumentation, notable for supporting MSP430 and RISC-V where AFL++ QEMU mode has no coverage. ISSTA 2023.

items.title: μEmu
items.description: Infers peripheral behavior from invalid-access patterns under symbolic execution, then drives AFL-based fuzzing of bare-metal MCU firmware without physical hardware. USENIX Security 2021.

items.title: SAFIREFUZZ
items.description: Rewrites ARM Cortex-M firmware via dynamic binary rewriting to run as a Linux userspace process on ARM servers, achieving ~600× the fuzzing throughput of HALucinator. USENIX Security 2023.

items.title: DICE
items.description: Automatically identifies and emulates DMA input channels in MCU firmware, enabling fuzzers to exercise DMA-driven code paths that were previously opaque. IEEE S&P 2021.

items.title: μAFL
items.description: Hardware-in-the-loop fuzzer using ARM ETM trace hardware to collect coverage from a real MCU without any firmware instrumentation. Found 8 CVEs in STM32/NXP SDKs. ICSE 2022.

items.title: Tiguard
items.description: An FTDI FT2232H-based multi-protocol tool for hardware hacking.

items.title: Bus Pirate
items.description: Open source hacker multi-tool that talks to electronic stuff. It's got a bunch of features an intrepid hacker might need to prototype their next project.

items.title: LUNA
items.description: FPGA-based USB analysis and development platform from Great Scott Gadgets, enabling USB sniffing, protocol fuzzing, and custom USB peripheral development via Amaranth HDL.

items.title: JTAGenum
items.description: Enumerates JTAG pinouts on unknown boards by brute-force testing candidate pin mappings.

items.title: JTAGulator
items.description: Automates discovery of JTAG, SWD, and UART debug interfaces on unknown PCBs by brute-forcing pin combinations, with sigrok-compatible logic analyzer mode and direct OpenOCD integration for post-discovery exploitation.

items.title: CHIPSEC
items.description: Platform security assessment framework with firmware and chipset checks relevant to offline dump triage.

items.title: NANDO
items.description: Open hardware STM32-based parallel NAND flash programmer with chip autodetection, bad block handling, and an extensible chip database; targets the parallel NAND found in older routers, set-top boxes, and automotive ECUs.

items.title: SNANDer
items.description: CLI programmer for SPI NOR/NAND flash and I2C EEPROMs using the ubiquitous $3 CH341A USB chip, extending it with NAND support beyond what proprietary software provides — the go-to for quick firmware dumps from IoT hardware.

items.title: ChipWhisperer
items.description: An open-source toolchain for side-channel power analysis and fault injection attacks with complete hardware and software stack.

items.title: lascar
items.description: Fast Python SCA library from Ledger's hardware wallet security team supporting CPA, DPA, MIA, template attacks, and ML-based attacks with lazy loading for large trace datasets.

items.title: scared
items.description: Industrial-grade side-channel analysis framework from eShard with best-in-class trace processing performance; supports CPA, DPA, TVLA/NICV leakage assessment, and very large trace datasets.

items.title: SCALE
items.description: Side-Channel Attack Lab Exercises providing educational material for learning power analysis attacks with low-cost hardware.

items.title: PicoEMP
items.description: NewAE's open hardware EMFI tool built on a Raspberry Pi Pico and photographic-flash transformer circuit; the community standard entry-level electromagnetic fault injection platform.

items.title: PicoGlitcher
items.description: RP2040/RP2350-based voltage glitching platform with 66A crowbar, sub-10ns pulse resolution via PIO sampling, and a high-level Python () API for scripting attack campaigns. Validated by SySS Research.

items.title: Faulty Cat
items.description: Low-cost open hardware EMFI tool from Electronic Cats built on an RP2040, offering both electromagnetic and crowbar voltage-glitching fault injection with single-shot and parameter-sweep campaign modes.

items.title: EM-Fault-It-Yourself
items.description: Motorized XYZ-stage EMFI platform targeting desktop and server SoCs (successfully attacked the AMD Secure Processor), with 2.5µm accuracy, 100mm travel, and a web UI for automated scanning campaigns. IEEE HOST 2022.

items.title: Proxmark3
items.description: Open-source RFID research platform for low-level interaction, analysis, and testing across a wide range of LF and HF tags and systems.

items.title: ChameleonUltra
items.description: Pocket friendly powerful LF and HF emulation & manipulation tool which is based on the open-source project ChameleonMini.

items.title: Awesome Flipper Zero
items.description: A collection of Awesome resources for the Flipper Zero device.

items.title: HardwareAllTheThings
items.description: Actively maintained hardware and IoT pentesting wiki by swisskyrepo covering fault injection, JTAG/SWD/UART exploitation, firmware dumping, side-channel attacks, and RF attacks with practical tooling references.

items.title: DVRF
items.description: Damn Vulnerable Router Firmware: modified Linksys firmware containing intentional MIPS/ARM binary exploitation challenges (buffer overflows, format strings, heap bugs) runnable under QEMU without physical hardware.

items.title: DVID
items.description: Damn Vulnerable IoT Device: open hardware ATmega328p board (Gerbers published) purpose-built for practicing UART extraction, firmware dumping, and Bluetooth sniffing attacks on physical hardware.
